watchlist.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
watchlist.reason: Broad market benchmark. Early November, post-October seasonality. Direction here sets the tone for all other names. Watching 578/585 range for intraday bias.
watchlist.notes: Most liquid instrument on the board. If SPY loses 578 on volume, step back from all longs. If it clears 585 cleanly, favor continuation setups on NVDA/AAPL.

watchlist.name: Invesco Nasdaq-100 ETF
watchlist.reason: Tech-heavy index anchor. Correlated to NVDA, INTC, AAPL, NFLX. Early November momentum watch. Key 490/496 zone.
watchlist.notes: Use as confirmation filter: only take long setups in NVDA/AAPL when QQQ is above pivot. If QQQ is red and trending down, skip discretionary tech longs.

watchlist.name: Nvidia Corporation
watchlist.reason: AI chipmaker sitting just above round-number $200 support. ATR $6.52 (3.2% of price) gives clean intraday range. Watch for ORB break above 210 or failure below 200.
watchlist.notes: No premarket quote; wait for ORB to form (first 15 min). Round $200 is a strong support; break below it with volume = avoid long. Break above 210 = continuation long with stop below ORB low.

watchlist.name: Intel Corporation
watchlist.reason: Highest avg volume of original candidates (4.27M/day). ATR $6.80 on a $65 stock = ~10% daily range — very elevated. Intel restructuring story means big moves possible. Most potential for range trade.
watchlist.notes: ATR/price ~10% — size positions smaller than normal (ATR-based stop will be wide). No premarket quote. Watch for first 15-min ORB; a clear break in either direction can run. Do not fade a strong trend in INTC — momentum setup only.

watchlist.name: Netflix Inc.
watchlist.reason: Has premarket data (62.05 vs 62.09 close = -0.06% gap, essentially flat). Spread 11.3bp is acceptable. Near-flat open suggests range-bound early action = mean-reversion or range fade around prior levels.
watchlist.notes: Only name with a valid premarket quote and known spread. Flat gap means no directional bias at open — wait for 15-min ORB to establish. Fade extremes toward pivot if volume is light; follow ORB break if volume is heavy.

watchlist.name: Apple Inc.
watchlist.reason: Most liquid US equity by volume. Best-in-class spread. Early November: holiday quarter momentum building. Always-on watch for intraday directional move if SPY/QQQ confirm trend.
watchlist.notes: No premarket quote but spread will be very tight at open. Highest liquidity on the list — easiest entry/exit. Only trade with SPY/QQQ confirmation. Holiday quarter tends to favor AAPL longs on dips to support.
